name: test-fastpath
description: Synthetic fixture target used ONLY by tests/target_definition/run_test.sh -- proves tools/polygraph's declarative L1/L2/L3 pipeline against a known ground truth (libfake_accel.c), independent of any real-world project's build quirks. Not a real-world preset; not listed for judges via `polygraph list` scope (it lives under tests/, not tools/targets/).
why_it_matters: A test fixture, not a product claim.

l1.note: Ground truth: exactly 2 matching symbols (poly_fastpath_avx_add, poly_fastpath_scalar_add), plus poly_fastpath_workload (has the prefix but doesn't match the _add$ dispatch_regex, so it counts toward the prefix-filtered total but not the matched count).

l2.note: fake_main ALWAYS prints 'selected: fastpath=avx' regardless of which function it actually calls -- see main.c's header. This is what lets run_test.sh's 'silent fallback' scenario exist at all.

l3.note: Non-halting breakpoint dispatch count, same mechanism as every real preset.

workload.note: {n} = call count, {actual} = which symbol family really runs ('avx' or 'scalar') -- see main.c. Override both via --param n=N --param actual=avx|scalar.
